description: Source code for a Python module 'environment.py' used in the Twister testing framework for Zephyr OS. Contains functions for argument parsing, environment setup, and interaction with CMake and Git.

classes.name: TwisterEnv
classes.description: Class managing environment setup, version control, and interaction with CMake for Twister testing framework.

methods.name: add_parse_arguments
methods.description: Defines command-line arguments for Twister framework.

methods.name: TwisterEnv.discover
methods.description: Discovers Zephyr version and toolchain info.

methods.name: TwisterEnv.check_zephyr_version
methods.description: Retrieves Zephyr version and commit date from Git.

methods.name: TwisterEnv.run_cmake_script
methods.description: Runs a CMake script with provided arguments and captures output.
